title: Maestro launches mining-backed Bitcoin credit market for institutions
summary: Maestro launched Mezzamine, a Bitcoin credit market linking institutional BTC holders with miners seeking capital backed by mining output.

title: PayPal expands PYUSD stablecoin to users in 70 countries
summary: PayPal is rolling out its PYUSD stablecoin in 68 additional countries beyond the US and UK, aiming to reduce cross-border fees and offer rewards on holdings.

title: ‘Bitcoin Standard’ author explores reality where decentralized gold stopped WWI
summary: Saifedean Ammous, the author of The Bitcoin Standard, released an alternate history last fall, in which a decentralized gold system uproots central banking.

title: Cango reports $285M Q4 loss as Bitcoin mining costs surge in 2025
summary: Cango shares fell from about $4.50 in October to around $0.68, declining more than 84% over six months amid losses and restructuring.

title: Stablecoins to replace old FX rails, but off-ramps remain a chokepoint
summary: Stablecoins are emerging as cheaper alternatives to costly legacy FX rails, but off-ramps such as bank account access add significant friction, according to Delphi Digital.

title: Bitcoin adoption metrics say one thing, price action says another
summary: Bitcoin adoption is surging across institutions, banks and corporations, but the price tells a different story. What explains the divergence?

title: DAOs may need to ditch decentralization to court institutions
summary: Crypto’s push into institutional adoption is forcing DAOs to choose between maintaining decentralization and business deals.

title: Five companies vie for Vietnam crypto licences as overseas ban looms: Report
summary: Five companies, including bank affiliates and a major conglomerate, are competing for Vietnam’s first crypto exchange licences as authorities plan to restrict offshore trading.

title: Decentralized compute has failed, so far
summary: Decentralized compute fails without cryptographic verification. Today's networks decentralize GPUs but centralize trust.

title: Cari picks ZKsync’s Prividium as US regional banks join stablecoin race
summary: Cari Network is building a bank‑governed tokenized deposit platform on ZKsync’s Prividium stack, giving US regional lenders a stablecoin‑style, onchain payments rail.
